description: The soundtrack every video model takes as input. Either text (up to 2000 characters) plus exactly one voice (voice_id from list_voices, or voice_user_id for a cloned voice), or file_path to upload a local WAV/MP3/M4A recording. Returns the clip id; it is ready when wait_for_job(model='audio-clip') reports done (usually seconds). Longer scripts: create several clips and pass all ids to create_craftstory2_video in order.

file_path.description: Local path of a recording to upload instead of text

voice_user_id.description: Cloned voice id (from list_voices with include_cloned)

name: create_audio_clip
title: Create an audio clip (speech from text, or upload a recording)
